name: 909 acid ride
desc: Classic acid-house 909 backbone: four-floor kick, clap on 2 and 4, ride-led 8ths riding a duck pump with slow lpf/pan drift. Clap rolls into 8-bar phrase ends; peak adds offbeat opens and a rotating rim euclid.

pump.doc: ride duck floor as fraction of gain

code.full: stack(s("bd*4").gain(${gain}).shape(.2), s("~ cp ~ cp").gain(${gain}*.7).room(.18).lastOf(8, x=>x.ply("<2 3>")), s("rd*8").gain(saw.range(${gain}*${pump}, ${gain}*.55).fast(4)).lpf(sine.range(${bright}*.45, ${bright}).slow(16)).pan(cosine.range(.35, .65).slow(24))).bank("RolandTR909").orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("bd*4").gain(${gain}).shape(.25), s("~ cp ~ cp").gain(${gain}*.72).room(.18).lastOf(4, x=>x.ply(2)), s("rd*8").ply("<1 1 1 2>").gain(saw.range(${gain}*${pump}, ${gain}*.58).fast(4)).lpf(sine.range(${bright}*.5, ${bright}).slow(8)), s("[~ oh]*4").gain(${gain}*.5).lpf(${bright}), s("rim(5,16,<0 2 4 6>)").gain(${gain}*.38).pan(sine.range(.3, .7).slow(12))).bank("RolandTR909").orbit(1).play()
